destination_ideas.name: City Palace
destination_ideas.why_fit: A royal complex showcasing Rajasthani architecture, museums, and courtyards. One of the major attractions in Jaipur.

evidence.note: Web-reported indicative data; dates and availability unverified. No pricing information available from source. Opening hours and entry fees should be confirmed directly.

destination_ideas.name: Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds)
destination_ideas.why_fit: An iconic five-story pink sandstone palace with 953 small windows (jharokhas) designed to allow royal women to observe everyday life and festivals without being seen. A landmark of Jaipur.

evidence.note: Web-reported indicative data; dates and availability unverified. No pricing information available from source. Opening hours and entry fees should be confirmed directly.

destination_ideas.name: Jantar Mantar
destination_ideas.why_fit: A collection of architectural astronomical instruments built by Maharaja Jai Singh II. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site featuring the world's largest stone sundial.

evidence.note: Web-reported indicative data; dates and availability unverified. No pricing information available from source. Opening hours and entry fees should be confirmed directly.

destination_ideas.name: Amber Palace (Amber Fort)
destination_ideas.why_fit: A majestic fort-palace complex built with red sandstone and marble, situated on a hilltop. Known for its artistic Hindu style elements, Sheesh Mahal (Mirror Palace), and Diwan-i-Aam (Hall of Public Audience).

evidence.note: Web-reported indicative data; dates and availability unverified. No pricing information available from source. Located on a hilltop; opening hours and entry fees should be confirmed directly.

destination_ideas.name: Jal Mahal (Water Palace)
destination_ideas.why_fit: A beautiful palace located in the middle of Man Sagar Lake. Built in Rajasthani and Mughal architectural styles, it appears to float on the lake. Visitable from the outside only.

evidence.note: Web-reported indicative data; dates and availability unverified. No pricing information available from source. The palace is not open for interior visits; viewing is from the perimeter.

stay_options.name: Jai Niwas (Arya Niwas Group)
pros: A renovated colonial bungalow family-managed hotel with a great garden, located in the heart of Jaipur. The property features ample gardens and public areas, and can host dinners, cultural shows, and weddings. Rooms are well-appointed and pleasant with amenities including TV with cable channels, air conditioning, high-speed Wi-Fi, electric kettle, writing desk, fridge, and attached bathroom with hot and cold water. The hotel has traditional/colonial style furnishings and offers ample parking, backup generator, money exchange, and taxi/tour assistance.
cons: Indicative published rate range of INR 3000–6500 per night across rooms (as per PDF pages 6–7). Rates vary by room type (single/double/family). Advance charged only for very busy dates; free cancellation till two days before arrival; discounts available for long-staying guests; no charge for small kids and half charges for 5–10 year olds (PDF pages 19–20). No date-specific quotes or availability claims.
